press.q: Next up is Reserved Team #2. What are you expecting?
press.a: Our side is very experienced and has been working hard these past couple of weeks, I have faith in the boys.
Because the opposition, Reserved Team #2 is a new team, I expect their result and their gameplay to represent that quite sharply.
Reserved Team #2, they will have some issues against our team.
Reserved Team #2 has a balanced playset, which just doesn't work and out playset is a lot better and actually works. We have got this one in the bag.
